taiwan-legal-db.title: Taiwan Legal Database
taiwan-legal-db.description: Stdio MCP server exposing twenty-six read-only tools over Taiwan's official legal sources: the judicial judgment portal (judgment.judicial.gov.tw), National Regulation Database (law.moj.gov.tw), Constitutional Court records (cons.judicial.gov.tw), the Judicial Yuan law database (legal.judicial.gov.tw), ministries' and local governments' interpretation, appeal and regulation systems, quasi-judicial bodies, the Legislative Yuan (lis.ly.gov.tw, ppg.ly.gov.tw), judicial and MOJ statistics, and open-access legal scholarship. Source: github.com/lawchat-oss/mcp-taiwan-legal-db.
